name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
summary: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Sprite Jumpsprocket works beside gnomish and dwarven artisans. Like many gnomes who sought refuge after Gnomeregan fell, she learns engineering among fellow tinkers.

sections.title: A Tinker in Stormwind
sections.body: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Sprite Jumpsprocket trains as an apprentice engineer. Gnomes and dwarves work side by side there, forging metal and shaping intricate devices. The capital gives apprentice tinkers room to learn from experienced masters. Their work keeps the Alliance's everyday mechanisms and marvels in good order.

sections.title: Gnomish Ingenuity in Exile
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell, displaced gnomes carried their skills in tinkering, chemistry, and mechanics across Alliance lands. In Stormwind, the Dwarven District offered them a welcome refuge, with blast furnaces and workbenches at hand. Sprite Jumpsprocket shares their resolve to master engineering despite the hardships her kin have faced.

faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is a female gnome apprentice engineer who lives and works in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Where can I find Sprite Jumpsprocket?
faq.answer: You can find Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, among the workshops, anvils, and fellow engineering enthusiasts.

faq.q: What role does she serve in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket trains as an apprentice engineer in Stormwind. She is one of the gnomish tinkerers honing their craft in the Alliance capital.

faq.q: Why are gnomes like Sprite living in Stormwind?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell, many gnomes sought refuge with their dwarven cousins in Ironforge and across human lands. Many settled in Stormwind City, where their industrial skill is in high demand.

faq.q: Is Sprite Jumpsprocket tied to any notable quests?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is part of the Dwarven District's engineering community.
Sprite Jumpsprocket is stationed in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. Engineering creations across the region often share gnomish designs.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can learn alongside Sprite Jumpsprocket among the sprockets, copper tubing, and volatile concoctions of Stormwind's most industrial district.
As a gnome, you share the perseverance of Gnomeregan's exiles. Far from their lost homeland, they keep their love of craft and mechanical mastery.
As an Alliance member, you can see how humans, dwarves, and gnomes work together in the Dwarven District. Their work helps keep the capital running.
